test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Vinod Mankara's documentary 'Mohinyattathinte Amma' is based on which of the following world renowned Mohiniyattam dancers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty:**
 
• Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma (1910-1999) is widely regarded as the "Mother of Mohiniyattam."
 
• She played a pivotal role in reviving and standardizing the classical dance form of Mohiniyattam.
 
• Her contributions involved refining the technique, expanding the repertoire, and establishing a structured training system.
 
• Vinod Mankara's documentary "Mohinyattathinte Amma" chronicles her life and legacy, highlighting her dedication to Mohiniyattam.
 
• She was a teacher at Kalamandalam, and trained many students.
 
• She brought structure to the dance form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jayaprabha Menon:**
 
• Jayaprabha Menon is a renowned Mohiniyattam dancer known for her graceful performances.
 
• She has contributed significantly to the promotion of Mohiniyattam through her performances and teaching.
 
• She is known for her abhinaya, or expressive dance.
 
• She has performed extensively both in India and abroad.
 
• She has received numerous awards for her contributions to Mohiniyattam.
 
• **P Madhuri:**
 
• P Madhuri is a respected Mohiniyattam dancer and instructor.
 
• She has dedicated her life to the dance form.
 
• She has trained many students.
 
• She is known for her traditional style.
 
• She has performed in various cultural events.
 
• **Sunanda Nair:**
 
• Sunanda Nair is a prominent Mohiniyattam exponent.
 
• She is known for her technical proficiency and expressive performances.
 
• She has performed and taught Mohiniyattam extensively.
 
• She has done research on the dance form.
 
• She has received many awards.
